# WillowPool reference

Fictional independent test reference.

WillowPool.leaseConnection performs the supported operation. The leaseTimeout field selects its parameter. A worker borrows an idle connection and returns it when work finishes. WillowPool uses this operation and field together. idle connection worker lease.

Use WillowPool.leaseConnection with leaseTimeout; changes become durable when the call returns. This document contains public reference information.
